about: Sitting 15a (the training hall and the dojo) and the storehouse of 16a, written early by hand as one file on 11 Oct 2026, straight after the owner chose 8b: each redone in place from the game's own picture, by the tool's own prompt (make_redo_workflow.redo_job) from the scratch record in which the three yards of the first ring are fixed. All three stand off the Training Yard, which is chosen.

The Forest Trail and the Riverside (17a) were meant for this file and are REFUSED by K8 in that record: 'Mountain Path has no chosen picture'. They, the three offices (12a) and everything else off the second ring wait for a scratch record in which the Staff Building Steps, the Main Gate and the Mountain Path are fixed from their chosen pictures, as the first ring was.

None of the three rooms has a keep list yet, so the installer's check cannot see additions: judge by eye against today's picture (tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py <place> <a> <b> --dry gives 'moved' and 'sharper').

read_2026_10_11.said: the owner, in chat, 11 Oct 2026: "The renders are in, take a look. But they need to be reworked like the other locations. Not just sharpened. Think about where they fit on the map, and I feel as if they would be more spacious. Whilst also staying accurate to the story, think about how the characters are going to interact with the space."
by_eye: All six keep today's layout, camera and size, as an in-place redo must: the training hall dim and full of pillars, the dojo small, the storehouse crowded under its loft with a post in the foreground.
The dojo's version A paints a lawn outside its windows where the chosen Training Yard is bare earth.
None shows its way out as a door a player could click.
read_2026_10_11.verdict: NOT USED, none of the six: the three rooms are composed again (plan: owner row O45; tools/art/staged/early/art_15r.json).
